answer: Synchronized personhood ceremonies issue one reward credential per person. For a glacier, tide or canyon monitoring job, the verifier checks a ceremony signature and an epoch nullifier, rejecting reused credentials. All venues meet simultaneously, so one body cannot enroll at several sites; N reward accounts require N people, whom an attacker must recruit or pay. This assumes honest attendance checks and no remote enrollment loophole; credential lending remains a bypass unless redemption checks presence too.
